ERROR 1.5.1 Ensure address space layout randomization (ASLR) is enabled medium L1
Evidence
[error] sysctl exit 1: sysctl: unknown oid 'kernel.randomize_va_space'
Remediation
Set kernel.randomize_va_space = 2 in /etc/sysctl.conf or a file under /etc/sysctl.d/ (e.g. /etc/sysctl.d/60-attestor-aslr.conf), then apply immediately: sudo sysctl -w kernel.randomize_va_space=2
Source

ERROR 1.5.2 Ensure ptrace_scope is restricted medium L1
Evidence
[error] sysctl exit 1: sysctl: unknown oid 'kernel.yama.ptrace_scope'
Remediation
Set kernel.yama.ptrace_scope = 1 (or higher) in /etc/sysctl.conf or a file under /etc/sysctl.d/ (e.g. /etc/sysctl.d/60-attestor-ptrace.conf), then apply: sudo sysctl -w kernel.yama.ptrace_scope=1
Source
